name: com.loopland.game
description: LoopLand: a premium Monopoly-style board game for VRChat worlds. Networked 2-6 player game, animated particle tokens, 3D dice, persistent Loop Coins, an in-game cosmetics store and VRChat Creator Economy (Udon Products) integration. One-click builders: LoopLand > Build Game In Scene, and LoopLand > Build LoopLand Tower World (tower, elevator, plaza and skyline with the game on top).
